facts_found: Before ordering a replacement credit card, the agent must verify the customer's identity, look up the credit card account, confirm the shipping address (primary or alternate, including unit/suite), record exactly one replacement reason, ask about expedited shipping with tier-based fees, and confirm replacement eligibility; the tool must not be unlocked or called unless the customer is eligible. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

order_replacement_credit_card_7291 is called via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool then call_discoverable_agent_tool with: the customer's credit card account identifier (account_id or card_id from the account lookup), reason, shipping_address, shipping_speed, expedited_fee_acknowledgement (consent captured only if a fee applies based on tier), and notes (e.g., travel dates, fraud report reference, delivery instructions). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]
Standard delivery is 7–10 business days with no fee for all cardholders; expedited delivery is 2–3 business days. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

Expedited shipping fees by tier: Entry-tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze) $15.00; Mid-tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $10.00; Premium-tier and above (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Platinum, Business Platinum, Diamond Elite) $0.00 complimentary. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

If the replacement reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, the bank strongly recommends expedited shipping to minimize exposure, and the customer should be reminded to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

A replacement request is rejected if a replacement request is already pending on the account (wait until it is delivered or cancelled), or if the tier replacement limit within a 60-day period is exceeded: Entry-tier 2, Mid-tier 3, Premium-tier and above 4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_004]
Customers who believe they have a legitimate need for a replacement beyond the tier limit can contact customer support to request a manual review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_004]

Pending replacement orders for an account are checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765(credit_card_account_id); order statuses can be pending, shipped, delivered, or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

Once a replacement is ordered, the current card is cancelled for security and cannot be used for new purchases, and a new card is created with a different card number and CVV. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

The credit card account number stays the same, so recurring payments linked to the account continue without interruption; the customer must still update saved card details with merchants after receiving the new card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

The customer receives an email when the replacement order is placed and another email when the card ships, and should follow the activation instructions included with the new card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

In file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829, card_action 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the user wants the card replaced — whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute; so the dispute and the replacement order are separate actions and the replacement can be ordered independently of the dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

After submitting a fraud_suspected replacement order, the agent must communicate the expected delivery window, advise watching for email notifications, remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website, and document the interaction and order details in the customer record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The credit card account identifier for these tools can be obtained with get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, which returns all active and closed credit card accounts for a user. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

The last four digits of a credit card can be retrieved with the tool get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id), which is needed for the card_last_4_digits argument of the dispute tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]
A pending replacement card order blocks account closure and credit-limit-increase requests until the replacement is delivered or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

Customer-facing guidance for fraudulent credit card charges is to contact Rho-Bank right away via 1-800-RHO-BANK, the mobile app, or rhobank.com/help (merchant contact is only required for non-fraud issues). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

facts_found: Customer-facing CLI guidance: gather current credit card account information, the new total limit requested or the dollar amount of the increase, and a brief reason for the increase; then contact support via secure in-app chat/secure message or phone; ask for a reference confirmation. Only the account owner or an authorized account manager may submit a CLI request. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Customer-facing guidance does not list income documentation as a required CLI input — only account info, requested amount/new total, and a brief reason; additional information may be requested during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

After a CLI submission, review takes a few business days with an email decision notification; if approved, the new limit takes effect as soon as the change is processed. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Pending replacement orders on a credit card account can be checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765(credit_card_account_id); any order in a non-final state (pending, shipped) blocks the account, and it clears only when delivered or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

Credit card dispute history, including dispute status (open/under_review/closed), can be retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) — usable to confirm whether an active dispute exists that blocks a CLI. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The Gold Rewards Card is a Premium-tier card; its approved credit limits typically range from $17,500 to $112,500 (initial limit set during underwriting from credit profile and supplied financial information). [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

Consent to a credit pull is documented as part of the Gold Rewards Card NEW APPLICATION process (minimum credit score $720), not in the CLI workflow documents. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

The CLI knowledge-base documents do not mention any income parameter, credit-pull consent step, or hard inquiry requirement in the CLI tools; the CLI tools accept only account/user identifiers, the increase amount, the new total limit, or a denial reason. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
